name: Moganopterus
isnote: Described as a boreopterid (Moganopterinae); later work recovers it as a ctenochasmatid.
sum: Extremely long-skulled toothed pterosaur from the Yixian Formation of Liaoning, China — the largest skull of any toothed pterosaur.
wsnote: Originally ~7 m; reduced to a maximum of 3.5 m in the 2022 redescription (Gao et al.).
material: Almost complete skull (~95 cm) with lower jaws and cervicals 2–4.
biology: Long, slightly recurved conical teeth along straight jaws; probably a fish-catcher.
author: Lü et al. 2012
